name: cloud-devops-skills

skills.name: automation-audit-ops

skills.name: canary-watch

skills.name: dashboard-builder

Use when writing a schema or data migration, adding a column or index to a large table, planning a rollback, or preparing a zero-downtime deploy.

skills.name: deployment-patterns

skills.name: e2e-testing

Use when running production agent fleets on PM2, systemd, or containers that need monitoring, incident response, or deployment gates.
